findings.passage: You can’t buy cold medicine, video games or even get into a concert without a valid ID. Certainly, every reasonable person can agree, you should be required to show ID to vote.
findings.note: Paid campaign release in his name, published on LebTown. Says a valid ID should be required to vote.

findings.passage: Those that use the mail in ballot system will need to provide a photocopy of their identification and signature to prove their identity, just as you would if you went to the polls.
findings.note: Same release. Says mail-in voters should provide a photocopy of ID and a signature.

findings.passage: One of the very first bills I co-sponsored last year was Senator Judy Ward’s SB755 calling for a constitutional amendment to implement Voter ID.
findings.note: Same release. Says he co-sponsored SB755, a voter ID constitutional amendment. Also says he supports ending Act 77 and has a way to hand a legal ID to anyone who needs one (same release: "We are at a point where we can easily deliver a legal ID to anyone who requires one.").
subjects: free ID for voters without one

findings.passage: That’s why I support the reinstitution of Voter ID laws.

findings.passage: “For instance, in-person voters and mail-in voters should be treated equally, and signature verification is a must.

findings.passage: One of these amendments would require all voters to present a valid form of identification prior to voting in person or by mail.
